question: Which of the following options is NOT one of the meanings of the homonym 'record'?

options.text: A written account or documentation of facts or events
A musical performance done entirely without instruments
To capture audio or video for future playback
The best or highest achievement in a particular field

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. A musical performance done entirely without instruments.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"record"** has multiple meanings depending on the context in which it is used. (रिकॉर्ड)
 
• **Meaning 1:** A written account or documentation of facts or events. (तथ्यों या घटनाओं का लिखित दस्तावेज)
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist kept a record of the experiment's results in his notebook.
 
 
 
• **Meaning 2:** To capture audio or video for future playback. (भविष्य में चलाने के लिए ऑडियो या वीडियो रिकॉर्ड करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The band decided to record their new album in a professional studio.
 
 
 
• **Meaning 3:** The best or highest achievement in a particular field. (किसी विशेष क्षेत्र में सर्वश्रेष्ठ या उच्चतम उपलब्धि)
 
 
• **Example:** Usain Bolt holds the world record for the fastest 100-meter sprint.
 
 
 
• The phrase "a musical performance done entirely without instruments" does not represent a meaning of the word "record." This makes it the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. A musical performance done entirely without instruments.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 1: A written account or documentation of facts or events** (तथ्यों या घटनाओं का लिखित दस्तावेज)
 
 
• **Example:** The school maintained a record of all student achievements for the year.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To capture audio or video for future playback** (भविष्य के प्लेबैक के लिए ऑडियो या वीडियो रिकॉर्ड करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to record a video message for her friend who lives abroad.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: The best or highest achievement in a particular field** (किसी विशेष क्षेत्र में सर्वश्रेष्ठ या उच्चतम उपलब्धि)
 
 
• **Example:** Breaking the previous record, the athlete achieved a new personal best in the marathon.
